# Λογιστικά Ρισσέτης

> Accounting firm in Pagkrati, Athens (Φιλολάου 27 και Τιμοθέου, 116 33). Accountant Georgios Rissetis provides accounting, tax services, and payroll for businesses and individuals. Phone: +30 213 006 8883. Email: logistikarissetis@gmail.com.

Hours: Mon/Wed 09:00–15:00; Tue/Thu/Fri 09:00–14:00 & 17:00–20:00; Sat/Sun closed. Appointments preferred. Free consultation available by appointment.
